verified_measurement_defects.summary: Research Agent and Critic receive market_state plus hashed artifact refs, not numeric PIT facts; candidate space is one operator, one frozen threshold, two directions.
Critic prompt and payload contain episode.to_dict() and hypothesis.to_dict() only; no deterministic window, cost, sample, fold, embargo, PIT, or multiple-testing budget digest.
Scorecard decision is hardcoded STOP/PIVOT. clean_hypothesis_retention uses SELECT over all executable reviews instead of a gold-label clean/bad set.

Hypothesis schema allows net_directional_mean, but replay ResultPacket metrics are signal_accuracy, proxy_net_return, stressed_net_return, and related names. Template verdict reads those proxy fields.
Template and single-prompt arms share the same template Hypothesis and ResultPacket, so 8/8 verdict agreement is not evidence against multi-agent value.

repair_scope: shared numeric ResearchEvidenceBundle for Research and Critic
direction/control/primary_metric mapped to actual ResultPacket fields
gold-label clean/bad hypothesis set for critic retention and recall
computed Discovery Gate, no hardcoded decision
two known-clean canary episodes with full arm 2/2 SELECT then experiment then result feedback
only after canary pass: freeze a new roster, run eight new episodes, then user blind eval
formal_pivot_only_if_repaired_round_stil: critic false-kills gold-label clean hypotheses at high rate
full-loop blind preference does not beat single-prompt
critic does not reduce known-bad hypotheses entering experiments
